content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "translated_stanza", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "misfortunes come thronging as if through gates thrown open", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "to them; Death hastily asserts his supremacy over every", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "helpless creature that is born; what thing is there then, that", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "despotic Fate has made immune from danger ?", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "translated_stanza", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "35. Enjoyments are transient like high surging waves; life", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "is liable to pass away in a moment; youthful happiness lasts", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "for a few days only; love for the cherished is fickle; knowing,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "therefore, that the entire worldly existence is destitute of any", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "good, ye wise men, givers of advice, make the attempt with", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "a mind skilful in ( or, intent on) doing good to the people.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "translated_stanza", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "36. Sensual objects are as ephemeral as the lightning", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "shining in the midst of the cloudy canopy; life is frail like", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "the water collected in the row of clouds scattered by the wind;", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "momentary is the youthful happiness of mortals; taking this", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "into consideration, O wise men, fix your mind at once on", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "contemplation of the Supreme Spirit, which it is easy to do", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "when one is a perfect master of ( lit. by being perfect in )", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "patience and concentration.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "translated_stanza", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "37. Life is fickle like a swelling wave; the splendour", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "of youth remains only for a certain number of days; wealth", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "is, like thought, momentary; pleasures are like the flashes", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "of lightning in autumn; even the embrace of the beloved,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "encircling the neck, lasts not for a long time; so have your", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "attention concentrated upon Brahman, that you should cross", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "the ocean of worldly dangers.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "translated_stanza", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "38. With their bodies cramped, men have to remain with", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "difficulty in the womb in the midst of impurities; in youth", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "the enjoyment of pleasures is difficult on account of the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "distraction arising from the pain of separation from one’s", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "beloved; surely old age too is unwelcome, ( for at that", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "period ) the refractoriness of women is conspicuous; say", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "oh men, if there is even the least happiness in worldly life ?", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "[ 32 ]", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "translation", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5", "u6"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "translated_stanza", "number": "34", "label": "34", "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "translated_stanza", "number": "35", "label": "35", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "translated_stanza", "number": "36", "label": "36", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "translated_stanza", "number": "37", "label": "37", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r5"]}, {"id": "u6", "type": "translated_stanza", "number": "38", "label": "38", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r6"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
